identity.name: Sharan Srinivas
identity.title: Associate Professor and Director of Graduate Studies
identity.proposition: Operations Research + AI for Intelligent, Resilient & Autonomous Systems
identity.intro: I develop optimization, simulation, and AI methods for complex operational systems, with applications in resilient supply chains and logistics, autonomous and human-robot operations, advanced mobility and logistics systems, and service systems engineering.
identity.cvLinkNote: Use a public PDF or approved external CV URL; never the source Word file.
identity.conceptualVisual: Operations Research + Artificial Intelligence → Intelligent Decision Systems
